_comment: Reference config shape. Two real source shapes are supported for mode=facecam — pick whichever matches what Cutter hands off.
hook_text: He didn't expect THIS to happen
_gore_check_passed_note: Set true only after a human has watched the first 7s and confirmed no heavy gore/dismemberment (YouTube monetization rule). The script refuses to render otherwise.
_radio_mute_windows_note: Time ranges (seconds, in the OUTPUT clip's own timeline) where in-game radio/licensed music is audible. They get hard-muted. There's no automatic radio detector here -- Cutter or Yuriy flags the windows by ear when clipping.
_captions_words_json_note: [{"word": "...", "start": 0.0, "end": 0.4}, ...] in the clip's own timeline. Get this from AutoClip's existing transcription step (backend/utils/speech_recognizer.py / the step1-2 pipeline), not from this template.
mode_gameplay_only_note: For mode=gameplay_only, drop the facecam fields and just set gameplay_path to the full clip.
